description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShop" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginCredentials" name="Login credentials"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginConfirmation" name="Login confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_SelectionCompleted" name="Product selection completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentAddressCompleted" name="Payment and address completed"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_OnlineShop" name="Ordering in an Online Shop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_EShop" name="E-Shop System" processRef="Process_EShop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Bank" name="Bank"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Login" name="Login credentials" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Start_Login"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginConfirmation" name="Login confirmation" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLoginResult" targetRef="Catch_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SelectionCompleted" name="Product selection completed" sourceRef="SendTask_SubmitSelection" targetRef="Catch_SelectionCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentData" name="Payment data" sourceRef="Task_EnterPayment" targetRef="Part_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation" sourceRef="Part_Bank" targetRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentAddressCompleted" name="Payment and address completed" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCompletion" targetRef="Catch_PaymentAddress"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Customer starts shopping"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Login" name="Log in to E-Shop system"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_LoginConfirmation" name="Login confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginConfirmation" messageRef="Msg_LoginConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_LoginCheck" name="Login successful?" default="SF_C5"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ShoppingStopped" name="Shopping stopped"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_ProductMerge" name="Product selection merge"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_AllSelected" name="All products selected?" default="SF_C10"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SubmitSelection" name="Submit product selection"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Split_Payment" name="Payment and address split"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_EnterPayment" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShipping" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_BillingDiff" name="Billing address differs from shipping address?" default="SF_C19"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBilling" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_AddressMerge" name="Address entry merge"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Join_Customer" name="Payment and address join"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendCompletion" name="Send payment and address completion"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderDone" name="Customer part completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C2" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Catch_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C3" sourceRef="Catch_LoginConfirmation" targetRef="Gw_LoginCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C4" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_LoginCheck" targetRef="Gw_ProductMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${loginSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C5" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_LoginCheck" targetRef="End_ShoppingStopped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C6" sourceRef="Gw_ProductMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C7" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C8" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C9" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Gw_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C10" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_AllSelected" targetRef="Gw_ProductMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C11" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_AllSelected" targetRef="SendTask_SubmitSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C12" sourceRef="SendTask_SubmitSelection" targetRef="Split_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C13" sourceRef="Split_Payment" targetRef="Task_EnterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C14" sourceRef="Task_EnterPayment" targetRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C15" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmed" targetRef="Join_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C16" sourceRef="Split_Payment" targetRef="Task_EnterShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C17" sourceRef="Task_EnterShipping" targetRef="Gw_BillingDiff"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C18" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_BillingDiff" targetRef="Task_EnterBilling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${billingAddressDiffers}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C19" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_BillingDiff" targetRef="Gw_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C20" sourceRef="Task_EnterBilling" targetRef="Gw_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C21" sourceRef="Gw_AddressMerge" targetRef="Join_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C22" sourceRef="Join_Customer" targetRef="SendTask_SendCompletion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C23" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCompletion" targetRef="End_OrderDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EShop" name="E-Shop System" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Login" name="Login credentials received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Login" messageRef="Msg_LoginCredentials"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendLoginResult" name="Send login confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_LoginResult" name="Login successful?" default="SF_E4"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginRejected" name="Login rejected"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_SelectionCompleted" name="Product selection completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_SelectionCompleted" messageRef="Msg_SelectionCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Split_Prep" name="Payment and shipment split"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Join_Prep" name="Preparation join"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PaymentAddress" name="Payment and address completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentAddressCompleted" messageRef="Msg_PaymentAddressCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CompleteOrder" name="Complete order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_E1" sourceRef="Start_Login" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_E2" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="SendTask_SendLoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_E3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLoginResult" targetRef="Gw_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_E4" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_LoginResult" targetRef="End_LoginRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_E5" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_LoginResult" targetRef="Catch_SelectionCompleted">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${loginSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_E6" sourceRef="Catch_SelectionCompleted" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_E7" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="Split_Prep"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_E8" sourceRef="Split_Prep" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_E9" sourceRef="Split_Prep" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_E10" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Join_Prep"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_E11" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Join_Prep"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_E12" sourceRef="Join_Prep" targetRef="Catch_PaymentAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_E13" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentAddress" targetRef="Task_CompleteOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_E14" sourceRef="Task_CompleteOrder" targetRef="End_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
